node.title: Rate-half MCA degree-guarded shifted-lattice witness adapter
node.statement: For every finite-field Reed-Solomon domain and k<m<=n, the weighted degree of any received-word lattice vector under the code shift k and effective shift k+1 differs by at most one, and the two minima obey the same bound. For a monic split complement locator W of degree omega=n-m with W|N, the effective envelope allows quotient c=N/W of degree at most k. It encodes an actual degree-<k explanation on the identical size-m support exactly when deg c<k, equivalently deg N<=omega+k-1 or the code-shift cap holds. Every actual explanation gives one unique guarded pair. Pair noncontainment is exactly the failure of both degree-<k tests on the unique support interpolants of u and v. Thus guarded data reconstruct an actual MCA-bad witness, but no Q/BC owner equivalence or coverage is claimed.
